skills.description: Replays a grid ladder against a price path and reports the round trips, the gross and net capture in USD, and the extremes the path reached. Read-only deterministic arithmetic with no market data.

prices.description: the price path to replay, oldest first

upperUsd.description: upper price of the range in USD

feeCostUsd.description: round trip cost applied to each trip

roundTrips.description: buy and sell pairs one rung apart

items.description: Replays a grid trading ladder against a price path the caller supplies: a lower price, an upper price, a rung count, a value per rung, an optional fee in basis points, and the path itself. It returns the rung spacing, how many distinct rungs the path touched, the round trips completed, the gross and net capture in USD, and the low and high the path reached. The arithmetic is deterministic and uses no market data, so the caller supplies the path and can reproduce every figure.

drift threshold, all supplied by the caller. It returns the portfolio total, the
current and target weight of each asset, the drift of each in percentage points,
whether either exceeds the threshold, and when one does, the value to move and in
which direction. The arithmetic is deterministic and uses no market data, so the
caller supplies the valuations and the plan follows from them.

items.description:

fee in basis points, all supplied by the caller. It returns the spacing between
rungs, the first and last rung prices, the value committed across the ladder, the
